description: Conducting the ‘Sri Lankan Day’ National Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, proposed at the Budget Speech 2025 to hold a National Programme called 'Sri Lankan Day' prioritizing the vision of creating a reconciled Sri Lanka by increasing understanding among the communities. The Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs has been entrusted with the responsibility of implementing the said programme. Accordingly, the 'Sri Lankan Day' programme is planned to be held on 12, 13 and 14 December 2025, in 04 zones viz the Colombo Municipal Council Playground and Viharamahadevi Park, including related premises surrounded by the main roads within that area with the participation of public and private sector. Further, the said programme has been prepared to be held in a manner that represents all ethnicities and religions comprising of programmes that include cultural elements and food cultures of each district, local industry exhibitions and sales, introducing opportunities for innovations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to hold the 'Sri Lankan Day' programme, was approved by the Cabinet.
